{{quote|He called himself Chaser. Mat figured that was because the women ran away from him after they got a look at that face, and he had to run after them.|[[Mat Cauthon]]'s thoughts on Chaser.}}
'''Chaser''' is the name given by a gambler at [[The Dead Man's Breath]].{{ref/book|13|8}}

==Appearance==
He is a tall fellow, with a pinched-up face that looked like it had been closed in a door a few times.

==Activities==
Chaser spread the rumor of [[Jowdry]]'s terrible murder, [[Mat]] overheard this while gambling in [[The Dead Man's Breath]]. Mat thought of the ''[[gholam]]'' and suddenly the dice began rattling inside his head.

== Trivia ==
* Chaser is named for Chase Moore, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
